supplier.name: Arctic Wellness
supplier.baseSource: Arctic Wellness's own site: prebuilt saunas 'assembled in our Dublin warehouse' (checked 10 Nov 2026). City only is shown.

intro: A Dublin team that designs, builds and installs saunas, ice baths and complete home wellness rooms, from the first conversation to the finished build.
standfirst: Every project includes installation: Arctic Wellness supplies the sauna or ice bath and fits it, working with your builder or architect where there is one. These are its own photographs of finished projects.

costs.title: What the listed price covers.
items: Arctic Wellness installs every project itself and quotes supply and installation together. Its site does not say whether the listed unit prices already include installation, so ask for the full quote.
Not stated beside the listed prices.
For a prebuilt sauna, the team prepares the base, the electrics and crane access before it is lifted in. These are handled within the project; their cost is not listed separately.
A socket within reach and a hose to fill it. Larger commercial baths may need plumbing, which Arctic Wellness arranges.
Priced per project. Typical lead time is 10 to 14 weeks; an existing design takes 5 to 6 weeks.
costs.note: Prices are those listed on arcticwellness.ie on 10 November 2026. Where no price is listed, the product is quoted per project.

considerations: A garden sauna is usually treated as a garden structure, and size, height and position limits apply. Arctic Wellness says it checks whether planning permission applies for each build; confirm this for your own garden.
Prebuilt saunas arrive in one piece and are lifted in by crane, so there needs to be a route for it. A custom build is made on site instead.
A sauna heater needs its own electrical supply. Arctic Wellness arranges the electrics as part of the project.
Cold immersion isn't for everyone. If you have a heart or blood-pressure condition, check with your doctor first.
